Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear context, this is exactly the sort of info we can share quickly. Im pasting the baseline hosted API pricing below and attaching our standard rate card for full detail. Ive ccd Laura on procurement questions and will loop Aditya on committed discount tiers.

Baseline hosted (public) list pricing — per 1M tokens:
- Small chat models (low-latency, ~8–32B): input $0.60 / 1M, output $0.90 / 1M
- Medium chat models (balanced, ~33–70B): input $1.10 / 1M, output $1.65 / 1M
- Large chat models (best-quality, >70B): input $2.40 / 1M, output $3.60 / 1M
- Embeddings (high-dim): $0.75 / 1M tokens
- Reranking / specialized tokens: quoted on request

Notes:
- We price input/output separately because usage patterns differ and many customers optimize prompt context size.
- Quantized variants (8-bit/4-bit) are available for a subset of models; those typically reduce output rates by ~15–25% in our committed pricing when used in Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted API we provide quantized model variants where applicable; details in the attached rate card.
- Latency bands: small (<80ms per token tail on A100-class infra), medium (~120–250ms), large (variable; 200–450ms depending on sequence length). These are baseline medians—see per-model profiles in the catalog link.

Quick answers to your bullets:
1) Separate input vs output rates (see table above).
2) We offer volume discounts starting at 10% for 6–12 month token commitments (sliding scale at higher tiers). Aditya will share tier thresholds.
3) Full model catalog (with vCPU/GPU footprint and median per-token latency) is here: https://redwood.app/models/catalog (public view). I also attached the Q4 rate card PDF.

If youd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through model choices for chat vs embeddings and estimate likely spend for your batch embedding volume. Would Thursday 11/07 10:00 PT work?
